title: Bar
description: Progress or health bar UI element for displaying values visually.
content:
Bar

Progress or health bar UI element for displaying numeric values as a filled bar.

Component UI

Schema

JSON
"bar": {
  "value": 0.0,
  "maxValue": 0.0,
  "color": "...",
  "direction": "..."
}

Description

The Bar component is a UI element for displaying progress or resource values visually as a filled bar. It renders a fillable bar commonly used for health bars, mana bars, experience bars, stamina indicators, and other progress displays. The bar fills proportionally based on the ratio of the current value to the maximum value.

Fields

NameTypeDescription
valuefloatThe current value of the bar.
maxValuefloatThe maximum value the bar can represent.
colorstringThe fill color of the bar (e.g., "#ff0000", "red").
directionstringThe fill direction of the bar ("left", "right", "up", "down").

Example

JSON
{
  "components": {
    "bar": {
      "value": 75.0,
      "maxValue": 100.0,
      "color": "#e74c3c",
      "direction": "right"
    }
  }
}
